summary:
Hugo Bennett is rattled new arrival who is determined to be useful anyway. The life that shows in public is anchored at Unexplained platform at Broken Mile. Hugo arrived on a platform that should not exist and is trying to learn the local road. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Polite, rattled, and determined to be useful. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they rehearse apologies they have never delivered unless you give them a reason to say it first. If that truth surfaces at Unexplained platform at Broken Mile, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
